# Introduction

This notebook extracts UMAP coordinates, VISION signature scores, and
Seurat metadata from saved VISION objects, then writes one merged score
table per dataset.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load required packages
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(Seurat)
library(VISION)
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(here)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Define inputs and outputs
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Directory containing saved VISION objects
INPUT_VISION_DIR <- here("output", "4.downstream_pipelines", "vision", "data", "vision_objects")

# Candidate directories containing matching Seurat objects
INPUT_SEURAT_DIRS <- c(
here("output", "4.downstream_pipelines", "vision", "data", "cleaned_datasets_human"),
here("output", "4.downstream_pipelines", "vision", "data", "cleaned_datasets_mouse")

)

# Output directory for extracted signature score tables
OUTPUT_DIR <- here("output", "4.downstream_pipelines", "vision", "data", "vision_signature_scores")
dir.create(OUTPUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Skip datasets if an output already exists
skip_existing <- TRUE
```

# Helper functions

```{r}
extract_dataset_name <- function(vis_file) {
  full_dataset_name <- sub("_VISION.rds$", "", basename(vis_file))
  dataset_name <- sub("^(\\d{4}_\\d{2}_\\d{2}_)?", "", full_dataset_name)
  dataset_name <- stringr::str_remove(dataset_name, "_Dataset")

  list(
    full_dataset_name = full_dataset_name,
    dataset_name = dataset_name
  )
}

find_matching_seurat_file <- function(dataset_name, search_dirs) {
  all_files <- unlist(
    lapply(search_dirs, function(x) list.files(x, full.names = TRUE)),
    use.names = FALSE
  )

  grep(
    pattern = paste0(dataset_name, ".*\\.rds$"),
    x = all_files,
    value = TRUE
  )
}
```

# Identify VISION objects

```{r}
vision_files <- list.files(
  path = INPUT_VISION_DIR,
  full.names = TRUE,
  pattern = "_VISION.rds$",
  recursive = TRUE
)

list.files(OUTPUT_DIR)
```

# Extract signature scores and metadata

```{r}
for (vis_file in vision_files) {
  dataset_info <- extract_dataset_name(vis_file)
  full_dataset_name <- dataset_info$full_dataset_name
  dataset_name <- dataset_info$dataset_name

  message("Processing: ", full_dataset_name)

  output_file_name <- paste0(full_dataset_name, "_VISION_sigScore.csv")
  output_file <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, output_file_name)

  if (skip_existing && file.exists(output_file)) {
    message("Skipping ", full_dataset_name, ": output file already exists")
    next
  }

  if (skip_existing && any(grepl(dataset_name, list.files(OUTPUT_DIR)))) {
    message("Skipping ", dataset_name, ": similar output file already exists")
    next
  }

  seurat_file <- find_matching_seurat_file(dataset_name, INPUT_SEURAT_DIRS)

  if (length(seurat_file) == 0) {
    warning("No matching Seurat file found for dataset: ", dataset_name)
    next
  }

  if (length(seurat_file) > 1) {
    warning("Multiple matching Seurat files found for dataset: ", dataset_name, ". Using the first match.")
    seurat_file <- seurat_file[1]
  }

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Load Seurat metadata
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  s.object <- readRDS(seurat_file)
  meta <- s.object@meta.data %>%
    rownames_to_column("barcode")
  rm(s.object)

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Load VISION object and extract UMAP and signature scores
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  vis <- readRDS(vis_file)

  umap_df <- as.data.frame(getProjections(vis)[["Seurat_umap"]]) %>%
    rename_with(tolower) %>%
    rownames_to_column("barcode")

  signature_df <- as.data.frame(getSignatureScores(vis)) %>%
    rownames_to_column("barcode")

  graph_data <- umap_df %>%
    left_join(signature_df, by = "barcode") %>%
    left_join(meta, by = "barcode")

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pivot signature scores into long format
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  sig_names <- names(signature_df)[-1]

  graph_data <- graph_data %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(sig_names),
      names_to = "Hallmark",
      values_to = "sigScores"
    ) %>%
    mutate(dataset = dataset_name) %>%
    mutate(across(any_of(c("sample", "cell_type", "subject", "region")), as.character))

  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Save extracted scores
  # -----------------------------------------------------------------------
  write.csv(graph_data, file = output_file, row.names = FALSE)
}
```
